entries.title: Show HN: Open-source macOS AI copilot (using vision and voice)
entries.author: ralfelfving
entries.current_title: Show HN: Open-source macOS AI copilot using vision and voice
entries.excerpt: Heeey! I built a macOS copilot that has been useful to me, so I open sourced it in case others would find it useful too. It's pretty simple: - Use a keyboard shortcut to take a screenshot of your active macOS window and start recording the microphone. - Speak your question, then press the keyboard shortcut again to send your question + screenshot off to OpenAI Vision - The Vision response is presented in-context/overlayed over the active window, and spoken to you as audio. -
entries.guide_zh: 开源 macOS AI 助手结合活动窗口截图与语音，让用户直接询问屏幕内容。

entries.current_title: Report Phone Spam – Shut down robocallers and text spammers
entries.excerpt: Do you receive unsolicited phone calls or SMS/text spam? I made a free public service site explaining how to find the telecom carrier that is responsible for the spammer's (real) phone number and report the abuse to them – so the carrier can terminate their service. It works, and it feels like magic. Background: Earlier this year, I wrote an HN comment[1] explaining how to find the telecom carrier responsible for a robocall or SMS spam campaign. entries.excerpt: Hi HN! I built Agora as a side-project leading up to the holiday season. I wanted to find an easier way to find Christmas gifts, without needing to go store-by-store.
